disclaimer: Fictional records for the ResolveNest demo. Not real customers, people or support conversations.

records.subject: PDF export cuts off right-hand columns
records.description: Our weekly store performance report has 16 columns. Since the update last week the PDF export only shows the first 12 columns; the rest are missing. Screen view is fine.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.1.1. Customer confirmed full-width PDFs after their upgrade.

records.subject: Weekly fleet report not delivered on Monday
records.description: The Monday 07:00 fleet utilisation report did not arrive for any recipient. Previous weeks were fine.
records.internal_notes: Matches legacy tracker item BUG-190 (mail relay retry). That item was archived before the tracker export.
records.resolution: Report re-sent manually. Mail relay retry fix was already deployed.

records.subject: Clinicians stuck in a login redirect loop
records.description: About a third of our users bounce between our identity provider and Ledgerline when signing in with SSO. Clearing cookies does not help.
records.internal_notes: SAML trace shows NotBefore about 2.5 minutes ahead of our clock.
records.resolution: Customer re-synced IdP clock as a workaround. Permanent fix in 2.2.1, deployed to their dedicated environment on 2026-05-14.

records.subject: Dashboard filters reset when going back
records.description: When we drill into a chart and then press Back, every filter on the dashboard is cleared. Our analysts have to set region and quarter again each time.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.2.1.

records.subject: Claims summary report arrived twice on Sunday
records.description: Our 02:00 claims summary was delivered twice on Sunday 29 March. Recipients are confused which one is correct.
records.resolution: Both copies were identical. Scheduler fix shipped in 2.2.0.

records.subject: 403 Forbidden when calling /v2/reports
records.description: Our LMS integration gets HTTP 403 with error 'insufficient_scope' on GET /v2/reports. GET /v2/accounts works with the same token.
records.internal_notes: Token only has accounts:read. Not a product defect.
records.resolution: Configuration: token was missing the reports:read scope. Sent KB-015; customer issued a new token and confirmed access.

records.subject: Member import fails: unexpected column
records.description: Importing our member list fails with 'Unexpected column \ufeffaccount_id'. The file is a CSV saved from our spreadsheet tool.
records.internal_notes: Workaround from KB-009 (save without BOM) sent.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.0; confirmed by customer after their upgrade.

records.subject: Role with no permissions could be saved
records.description: An admin created a role without ticking any permission. Users with that role see an empty workspace. Shouldn't the editor block this?
records.resolution: Product decided this is intended behaviour (wontfix). Pointed customer to KB-007.

records.subject: CSV columns in a different order than on screen
records.description: I dragged the 'Campaign' column to the front in the report viewer, but the exported CSV still has it in position 5.
records.resolution: Customer accepted the workaround (reorder in report definition). Bug remains open.

records.subject: Duplicate rows when paginating /v2/transactions
records.description: Our billing sync pulls 500 rows per page and ends up with duplicate transaction rows at every page boundary.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.0.

records.subject: Order webhooks arriving 10-15 minutes late
records.description: Since Tuesday our order.created webhooks arrive 10-15 minutes after the order is placed. Normally it is under 10 seconds.
records.internal_notes: Delivery logs show first attempts on time and several 503 responses from the receiver. Delays stopped on their own after two days. Root cause not identified.
records.resolution: Delays no longer observed. No root cause identified.

records.subject: Scheduled report email missing attachment
records.description: The monthly patient volume report email arrives with the text body but no attachment. The report has about 80,000 rows.
records.internal_notes: Attachment is 14 MB. Workaround: send as download link (KB-011).

records.subject: API returns 403 after token rotation
records.description: Our nightly ETL started failing with 403 'insufficient_scope'. Scopes have not changed. The token was created 90 days ago.
records.internal_notes: Token expired; API should have returned 401 token_expired.
records.resolution: Customer issued a new token. Misleading status code tracked as BUG-244 (still open).

records.subject: Dashboard numbers lag behind source data
records.description: Policy counts on the underwriting dashboard are up to 15 minutes behind the source system even after the dataset refresh completes.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.1.

records.subject: New hire cannot sign in with SSO
records.description: A new finance analyst gets 'User not assigned to this application' from our identity provider when opening Ledgerline.
records.resolution: Configuration: user was not assigned to the Ledgerline app in the customer's IdP. Pointed to KB-005.

records.subject: 403 on every API call from new integration server

records.internal_notes: Error body: 'ip_not_allowed'. Source IP not on the organization allowlist.
records.resolution: Configuration: added the new server IP to the API allowlist per KB-016.

records.subject: CSV export downloads an empty file
records.description: Since this week's update, exporting the 'Driver hours by depot' report to CSV shows 'Export failed (ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE)' and downloads a 0 KB file. Exporting the same report to XLSX works.
records.internal_notes: Report includes custom date field 'Shift Start'. Reproduced on 2.3.0.
records.resolution: Fixed by the 2.3.2 rollout. Customer confirmed CSV exports work again.

records.subject: ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE on monthly revenue report

records.internal_notes: Failing report has custom date field 'Invoice Paid On' with empty values.
records.resolution: Workaround (XLSX) used until 2.3.2. Customer confirmed fixed on 2026-08-06.

records.subject: Import progress stuck at 99%
records.description: Course enrolment imports sit at 99% forever. The records do appear in the system afterwards.

records.subject: Webhook deliveries delayed by about 20 minutes
records.description: During business hours our shipment.updated webhooks arrive around 20 minutes late. Overnight they are near real time.
records.internal_notes: Sampled deliveries left our dispatcher on time; customer receiver responded slowly (8-12 s) during peaks. Not conclusive.

records.description: The premium revenue widget still shows yesterday's total at 11:00, while the dataset shows today's refresh completed at 07:00.
records.internal_notes: Looks like BUG-219 at first glance, but that was fixed in 2.3.1. Widget had a 'cache for 24 hours' override.
records.resolution: Configuration: removed the 24-hour widget cache override.

records.subject: Order webhooks arriving late and out of order
